description: This source file defines the 'DataProductPublishingService' class, which orchestrates various workflow operations such as draft submission, validation, approval decision, and publishing within a data product management system. It includes methods for handling business logic, auditing, and error handling using custom exceptions. The class interacts with external models, repositories, and protocols imported from other modules in the project.
